pipeline: Blender (hero prep, headless) + Unreal Engine 5.4+ (scenes, Lumen/Nanite, Movie Render Queue). Default look is high-fidelity cinematic; anime-cinematic is a toggle only.
description: Starter asset pack for a 30-second cinematic solarpunk Lagos montage. Models include original glTF/GLB plus Unreal-ready FBX (centimetres, Z-up, pivot at the base). High-detail Poly Haven scans are in models/*/hd-*/. Textures are 4K. HDRIs include 4K EXR. All assets are CC0 1.0, CC-BY 3.0, or SIL Open Font License 1.1.
note: Run fetch-assets.ps1 (Windows) or fetch_assets.py first — it downloads the 4K textures, HDRIs and high-detail Poly Haven models listed here. Prefer Megascans (Fab, free in UE5) and the hd-* models in the foreground. Kenney meshes are low-poly and often toy-scale — use as blockout or restyle in Blender. Recolor the van as a yellow hover-danfo with black stripes (scale up to a midibus); recolor the motorcycle as a glowing electric okada (scale up slightly). school-bus.fbx and bicycle.fbx have incorrect source scale — see scale_note. Build anything missing procedurally. Quixel Megascans are not included in this pack.

fbx_export.textures: embedded on loose Kenney/pack FBX files; alongside the FBX in each hd-* folder
